description: The PB-25 RTO office in Jagraon serves as a Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) facility for the Punjab Transport Department. It manages all vehicle registration activities, issuance of driving licenses, and transport permit processing for the Jagraon sub-division of Ludhiana district.
address: SDM Office, Ferozepur Road, Jagraon, District Ludhiana, Punjab
